Definition: middle voice from G1537 and G2278; to "echo" forth, i.e. resound (be generally reported):--sound forth.
BiblicalUsage: exēchéomai is a plain word for sound forth. In 1 Thessalonians 1:8, the text says "For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia."
TheologicalSignificance: I take exēchéomai as it stands: sound forth.
